snippet.title: MICHAEL JACKSON SMOOTH CRIMINAL LIVE MEXICO 1993 - DANGEROUS WORLD TOUR
snippet.description:
Here are some details and dates for Michael Jackson’s legendary Dangerous World Tour performances in Mexico in 1993. These shows are especially significant in Michael Jackson's history, as they ended up being the very last performances of the entire tour.

Tour Dates in Mexico
All of the concerts took place in the fall of 1993. Originally, there were some scheduling shifts (a November 3rd show was postponed due to Michael having severe dental pain), but the final performed dates were:
October 29, 1993
October 31, 1993
November 7, 1993
November 9, 1993
 November 11, 1993 (The final show of the Dangerous World Tour)

Venue & Attendance

Venue: Estadio Azteca (Azteca Stadium) in Mexico City.

Attendance: Michael sold out the massive stadium for all five nights. Each concert held roughly 100,000 to 110,000 fans, bringing the total attendance in Mexico City to an incredible half a million people.

Historical Significance
The November 11th show in Mexico City marked the abrupt end of the *Dangerous World Tour*. Michael was dealing with immense stress from the 1993 child abuse allegations that had broken in the media during the tour, leading to severe dehydration, exhaustion, and a dependency on painkillers. Following the final Mexico City show, the remaining dates of the tour were officially canceled so he could seek medical treatment.

The Standard Setlist
The Mexico shows featured his spectacular Dangerous era stage production, complete with the iconic "toaster" entrance and the jetpack finale. 
The typical setlist for the Mexico City shows included:
 
1. **"Brace Yourself" / "Carmina Burana"** (Video Intro)
 2. **"Jam"**
 3. **"Wanna Be Startin' Somethin'"**
 4. **"Human Nature"**
 5. **"Smooth Criminal"**
 6. **"I Just Can't Stop Loving You"** (Duet with Siedah Garrett)
 7. **"She's Out of My Life"** 8.  **Jackson 5 Medley:** ("I Want You Back" / "The Love You Save" / "I'll Be There")
 8. **"Thriller"**
 9. **"Billie Jean"**
 10. **"Black Panther"** (Video Interlude)
 11. **"Will You Be There"**
 12. **"Dangerous"**
 13. **"Black or White"** (Often performed on a cherry-picker crane over the crowd)
 14. **"We Are the World"** (Video Interlude)
 15. **"Heal the World"**
 16. **"Man in the Mirror"** / Rocket Man Finale
